# INTERFACING HC-SR04 ULTRASONIC SENSOR WITH ARDUINO UNO&nbsp;

&nbsp;

&nbsp;

# AIM :

To design and implement a non-contact distance measurement system by interfacing an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor with an Arduino Uno development board

## Component :

![][image1]

### **WORKING PRINCIPLE**

1. The Arduino initiates a measurement cycle by applying a $10\\,\\mu\\text{s}$ digital high pulse to the sensor's **TRIG** pin.  
2. The transmitter transducer generates and transmits an ultrasonic acoustic wave pattern at a carrier frequency of 40kHz  
3. When the emitted acoustic wave strikes a target boundary, an echo reflects back toward the sensor receiver.  
4. The receiver detects the reflected wave and switches the **ECHO** output pin high for a period proportional to the round-trip acoustic travel time.  
5. The microcontroller reads the duration of the high pulse (t) via the pulseIn() timing routine.  
6. The distance is computed using the acoustic velocity constant in dry air .  
   &nbsp;

   #### CODE :

   const int trigPin \= 9;  
   const int echoPin \= 10;  
   &nbsp;  
   long duration;  
   float distance;  
   &nbsp;  
   void setup() {  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(trigPin, OUTPUT);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(echoPin, INPUT);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.begin(9600);  
   }  
   &nbsp;  
   void loop() {  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;// Clear the trigger pin  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(2);  
   &nbsp;  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;// Send a 10-microsecond trigger pulse  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, HIGH);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(10);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);  
   &nbsp;  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;// Measure round-trip time of the echo pulse  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;duration \= pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH);  
   &nbsp;  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;// Compute distance in centimeters  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;distance \= (duration \* 0.0343) / 2.0;  
   &nbsp;  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;// Print results to Serial Monitor  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.print("Distance: ");  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.print(distance);  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.println(" cm");  
   &nbsp;  
   &nbsp;&nbsp;delay(200);  
   }  
   &nbsp;

RESULT:

The HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor was successfully interfaced with the Arduino Uno microcontroller. The system delivered stable, real-time distance measurements across an operational sensing range of 2cm to 4cm  with high repeatability.&nbsp;
